nbis.headline: Mon cash $170.24 (+2.88%, +$4.77), range $166.59-176.69, vol 24.3M (CNBC). Cap $46.28B. Post $170.10 (−0.08%). About THB 5,715/sh at 33.57. Still −31.9% from 6 Oct $249.87.

nbis.headline: EDGAR: new Form 4 0001513845-26-000132 (filed 19 Oct). Director John Boynton IV sold 7,260 sh on 15 Oct (~$164.80-171.55), leaving 403,522. Nothing filed after it; no new 6-K.
nbis.why: Matches the Form 144 already reported. Immaterial; no dilution or guidance change.

nbis.headline: Truist reiterated Buy on Nebius and CoreWeave in a Sunday note, PT $355 for NBIS. It argued the failed Firmus IPO does not signal structural trouble for neoclouds with contracted backlog; cites 4.5x 2028 EV/sales.
nbis.why: Sell-side support after a ~21% weekly drop. Opinion, not new company data.

nbis.headline: Peer: Goldman upgraded CoreWeave to Buy (PT cut to $106 from $139); JPMorgan said CRWV debt and cash-burn fears are overblown. CRWV's 2031 bond yield eased 19.5bp to 15.13%, but the stock faded to close −0.44% at $61.12.
nbis.why: Credit stress is easing at the margin, which is what has driven the neocloud selloff. CRWV failing to hold gains shows the group trade is still fragile.

nbis.headline: Peer: Bloomberg reports Nscale and Anthropic are in talks on a second ~$45B compute deal, a ~460MW building at Nscale's West Virginia campus on Nvidia Vera Rubin. Talks ongoing. Nscale's ~$30B IPO valuation is meeting pushback.
nbis.why: Frontier-lab demand for neocloud capacity is intact even as equity investors mark valuations down. Supports the demand side of the NBIS thesis.
